banner.title: Cookies on this site
banner.message: Essential cookies keep this site working — sign-in, security, and your saved preferences. With your permission we would also measure how the site is used so we can improve it. You can change your mind at any time.

preferences.title: Cookies and analytics
preferences.description: Choose again whether this site may measure how you use it. Essential cookies are always on — the site cannot work without them.

mcp.title: Authorize {{client}}
mcp.description: {{client}} is asking to use your knowledge bases. It gets only what you select below. Its tools start on the Read preset; access to each knowledge base stays unselected until you select it.
mcp.previous: You approved this app before. Selecting only what you approved before keeps that approval; selecting more creates a new approval.
mcp.redirecting: Approved. Returning you to the app…
mcp.reused: Your existing approval for this app now matches this selection.
mcp.denied: Access denied. Returning you to the app…
mcp.restartBody: The request expired, was already used, or your selected access is no longer available. Earlier app approvals may still be active. Review them in Settings, then go back to your app and connect again.
mcp.sealedTitle: Sealed values can't be shared with apps
mcp.sealedBody: Sealed values require the kb command line or a personal access token. Nothing was approved. Connect the app again without sealed values, or use the kb command line.
mcp.errorBody: We couldn't finish this request. Try again.
mcp.incompleteBody: Your selected permissions were saved. An existing approval may have been narrowed, but returning to the app did not finish. Retry the same selection, or review and revoke this app in Settings before connecting again.
mcp.uncertainBody: The reply was lost. Your approval may have been saved. Retry this exact selection to confirm it, or review and revoke the app in Settings before connecting again.

device.title: Sign in the kb command line
device.description: The kb command line is asking to use your knowledge bases. It gets only what you select below. Its tools start on the Read preset; access to each knowledge base stays unselected until you select it.
device.compare: Only continue if this code matches the one shown in your terminal.
device.notAToken: This code is not a password or access token. Approving creates a new access token that goes only to your terminal.
device.expiry: The new access token expires in 90 days. You can revoke it at any time in Settings.
device.rightsChanged: Your selected knowledge-base or sealed-record access is no longer available. Nothing was approved in this attempt. Review your selection and try again.
device.errorBody: We couldn't finish this request. Try again.
device.enterDescription: Enter the code shown in your terminal.
device.codeInvalid: Enter the 8-character code exactly as shown, for example ABCD-2345.
device.approvedBody: Go back to your terminal. It finishes signing in on its own.
device.deniedBody: Nothing was approved. The terminal will report that the sign-in was denied.
device.unavailableBody: This code is wrong, expired, already decided, or used. An earlier approval may still have created an active access token. Check your terminal and review your tokens in Settings before starting another sign-in.
device.refusedBody: The request expired, your access changed, or this page failed a security check. Nothing was approved. Run the sign-in command again.
device.uncertainBody: We couldn't confirm the result. Your decision may have been saved and your terminal may already have an active access token. Check your terminal and review or revoke tokens in Settings.
device.signInBody: Your session ended. Sign in, then open the link from your terminal again.

recipients.title: Sealed values (optional)
recipients.hint: Compare this recipient key with your terminal. Select Read on the knowledge base, then add each exact sealed reference you own. Choose the Sealed values tool group under Advanced so the terminal can resolve them. Enrolled two-factor authentication is required. No sealed record is selected by default.
recipients.confirm: Approve this exact record for this recipient key

errors.readRequired: Select Read on this record's knowledge base above first.
errors.expiresAt: Pick a date and time within the next 90 days.

recipients.draftPending: The sealed record form still has input. Add the record, or clear the form, before you approve.
